title: 04.02 - Why selected answers disappear in a matrix question
intent: Explain why a participant selection may disappear when answering a matrix question.
short_answer: This can happen when the matrix question is configured so that each possible answer can be selected only once. This feature is often used to create a ranking between answers.
procedure: If the same answer cannot be used more than once, choose a different answer for each row or item.
Complete the matrix according to the allowed ranking or selection rules.
important_conditions: This behaviour is controlled by the survey author.
It is not necessarily an error; it may be an intended feature of the question.
